name: MqttBridge
short: Bridge Discord events and commands to MQTT
description: Bridge Discord events and commands to an MQTT broker. Generic, config-driven bridge that publishes structured payloads for external consumers.
install_msg: MqttBridge installed! Use `[p]mqttbridge set` to configure your MQTT broker connection.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. It transmits Discord user IDs and message content to a configured MQTT broker.
